title: Esau's Descendants

questions.question: What is another name for Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:1 (ESV): "These are the generations of Esau (that is, Edom)."

questions.question: Where did Esau settle?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:8: "So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom."

questions.question: Why did Esau move away from Jacob?
options: Their possessions were too great to dwell together
questions.correctAnswer: Their possessions were too great to dwell together
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:7: "For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together."

questions.question: From how many wives did Esau have sons?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:2-5: Esau had sons from Adah, Oholibamah, and Basemath.

questions.question: What people descended from Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:9: "These are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir."

questions.question: Who was Esau's grandson through Eliphaz?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:11: "The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz."

questions.question: Who was Amalek in relation to Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:12: "Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz...and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz."

questions.question: What type of leaders ruled Edom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:15-19: The sons of Esau became chiefs of their clans.

questions.question: Who were Esau's wives from?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:2-3: Esau married Canaanite women and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael.

questions.question: Did Edom have kings before Israel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:31: "These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the Israelites."

questions.question: Who were the Horites?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:20: "These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land."

questions.question: Who was Anah and what did he discover?
options: A chief who found hot springs in the wilderness
A shepherd who found a well
A priest who found an altar
questions.correctAnswer: A chief who found hot springs in the wilderness
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:24: "He is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness."

questions.question: How many kings of Edom are listed in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:31-39: Eight kings are listed who reigned in Edom.

questions.question: What was the name of Esau's first son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:10: "Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau."

questions.question: Who was Timna?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:12: "Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son; she bore Amalek to Eliphaz."

key_verse_text: So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
